chain.fact: If the three special recoveries return null, the authorized retry applies the current revision change and creates a pending attempt.
factoryChanged emits UI live invalidations only; it is not itself the execution wake.
The existing Worker has a once-per-minute cron trigger.
The authenticated recovery cron calls sweepFactoryWatchdog independently of the client.
Pending execution/check stages with no active run, including current runId=null, are eligible after updatedAt is at least one minute old. Dispatch is committed before the returned start closure runs.
The execution source comes from the same Task latest execute attempt. The input null run id does not prevent strict Profile selection; a cloud handoff explicitly accepts null previousRunId.
The durable workflow accepts previousRunId:string|null and owns handoff plus maintenance.
The owned/current queued-run query permits null previousRunId; only parking is conditional, while the new run still goes through normal start.

limits: This is source-path verification, not a live cron or production Review success result.
The HTTP pending response proves authorized retry acceptance only; it does not prove Review dispatch, native startup, or a passed Review.
Eligibility, current authorization, credential availability and strict Decision selection still govern the later attempt; a new refusal may safely block it again.
